x_query.oql:
get works where published since 2020-01-01
  and title-abstract has (earthquake AND (stemmed "benchmark dataset" OR stemmed "data availability" OR stemmed "data scarcity" OR stemmed "data sharing" OR stemmed "open dataset" OR stemmed "training data" OR interoperability OR standardisation OR standardization) AND (stemmed "rupture simulation" OR stemmed "synthetic seismograms" OR stemmed "wavefield simulation"))
  and published through 2025-12-31
  and type is ([article](article) or [review](review));
then, group those works by year
x_query.x_new_oql: get the count of works with (earthquake AND (stemmed "benchmark dataset" OR stemmed "data availability" OR stemmed "data scarcity" OR stemmed "data sharing" OR stemmed "open dataset" OR stemmed "training data" OR interoperability OR standardisation OR standardization) AND (stemmed "rupture simulation" OR stemmed "synthetic seismograms" OR stemmed "wavefield simulation")) in the title or abstract where type is ([article](article) or [review](review)) by year from 2020-01-01 through 2025-12-31
x_query.url: /works?filter=from_publication_date:2020-01-01,title_and_abstract.search:earthquake,to_publication_date:2025-12-31,title_and_abstract.search:%22benchmark dataset%22|%22data availability%22|%22data scarcity%22|%22data sharing%22|%22open dataset%22|%22training data%22|interoperability|standardisation|standardization,title_and_abstract.search:%22rupture simulation%22|%22synthetic seismograms%22|%22wavefield simulation%22,type:article|review&group_by=publication_year&per_page=200
